title: Bloop's Big Hop
description: A chunky 3D platformer. Run, hop, stomp enemies, bonk blocks from below, ride moving platforms and reach the flag through four worlds of three levels each: Meadow, Dunes, Deep Cavern and Sky Keep. Every level is built from hand-designed chunks tuned by a difficulty number, so gaps widen, enemies thicken and platforms speed up as you go. Three stars per level, lives, checkpoints, power-ups, a boss at the end of each world, and a leaderboard for score and stars.
